name: Genesis Resources Limited
summary: Genesis Resources Limited engages in the exploration for and evaluation of mineral properties in Australia and Macedonia. The company explores for copper, iron, gold, manganese, silver, and other base metals. It owns 6 exploration licenses covering an area of approximately 919.08 square kilometers in Queensland and the Northern Territory of Australia. The company, through a joint venture agreement, holds a 62% interest in the Plavica project that covers an area of 16.85 square kilometers located in the Kratovo district to the north east of Macedonia. Genesis Resources Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kew, Australia.
